examples.en: The building's ventilation needs regular maintenance.
examples.zh: 建筑的通风系统需要定期维护。

examples.en: The new ventilation removes air from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新的通风设备把空气从厨房排出。

entries.definition: spoken rather than written

examples.en: They reached a verbal agreement at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们在会上达成了口头协议。

examples.en: The tutor gave verbal feedback after the presentation.
examples.zh: 展示结束后，导师给了口头反馈。

entries.definition: relating to words and language

examples.en: The test measures verbal ability.
examples.zh: 这项测试衡量语言能力。

examples.en: Gestures can reinforce a verbal message.
examples.zh: 手势可以强化语言信息。

entries.definition: relating to verbs in grammar

examples.en: The lesson covers several verbal forms.
examples.zh: 这节课讲解几种动词形式。

examples.en: The suffix changes the word's verbal meaning.
examples.zh: 这个后缀改变了该词的动词意义。

entries.definition: to check that something is true or accurate

examples.en: Please verify the address before sending the parcel.
examples.zh: 寄包裹前请核实地址。

examples.en: Independent researchers verified the result.
examples.zh: 独立研究人员证实了这个结果。

entries.definition: a particular form or edition of something

examples.en: The updated version fixes several errors.
examples.zh: 更新版本修正了几个错误。

examples.en: A smaller version of the device is now available.
examples.zh: 现在可以买到这种设备的小型版本。

entries.definition: a person's account of an event

examples.en: We heard two different versions of the incident.
examples.zh: 我们听到了关于这件事的两种不同说法。

examples.en: Her version includes details missing from the report.
examples.zh: 她的描述包含了报告遗漏的细节。

entries.definition: a rendering of a text or work into another language or form

examples.en: I read the Chinese version of the novel.
examples.zh: 我读了这部小说的中文译本。

examples.en: The stage version is shorter than the original book.
examples.zh: 舞台改编版比原著短。

entries.definition: running straight up and down

examples.en: Draw a vertical line through the centre.
examples.zh: 画一条穿过中心的竖线。

examples.en: The climber faced a nearly vertical wall of rock.
examples.zh: 攀登者面对一面几乎垂直的岩壁。

entries.definition: a vertical line or direction

examples.en: The pole leans slightly away from the vertical.
examples.zh: 这根杆子略微偏离竖直方向。

examples.en: The diagram uses two verticals to mark the boundary.
examples.zh: 图中用两条垂线标出边界。

entries.definition: to examine carefully before approval

examples.en: The committee vets every application.
examples.zh: 委员会仔细审查每份申请。

examples.en: All volunteers are vetted before joining the programme.
examples.zh: 所有志愿者参加项目前都要接受审查。

entries.definition: a doctor who treats animals

examples.en: The vet examined the injured bird.
examples.zh: 兽医检查了受伤的小鸟。

examples.en: We took the cat to the vet for a check-up.
examples.zh: 我们带猫去兽医那里做检查。

entries.definition: able to work successfully in practice

examples.en: The team proposed a viable alternative.
examples.zh: 团队提出了一个可行的替代方案。

examples.en: The business needs a viable plan for growth.
examples.zh: 这家企业需要一个切实可行的发展计划。

entries.definition: capable of surviving and developing

examples.en: The test determines whether the seeds are viable.
examples.zh: 这项测试确定种子是否具有发芽能力。

examples.en: Only viable cells were counted in the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验中只统计了活细胞。

entries.definition: with the order or relationship reversed

examples.en: She translates from Chinese into English, and vice versa.
examples.zh: 她把中文翻译成英文，也把英文翻译成中文。

examples.en: The software converts text to speech and vice versa.
examples.zh: 这款软件把文字转为语音，也能反向转换。

entries.definition: to treat someone unfairly or cause them to suffer

examples.en: The policy protects workers who are victimised for raising concerns.
examples.zh: 这项政策保护因提出疑虑而受打击报复的员工。

examples.en: The story describes a child victimised by older pupils.
examples.zh: 故事描述了一个遭到高年级学生欺负的孩子。

entries.meaning: 糟糕透顶的；令人厌恶的
entries.definition: extremely unpleasant

examples.en: A vile smell came from the blocked drain.
examples.zh: 堵塞的排水管里传来一股恶臭。

examples.en: The weather was vile throughout the trip.
examples.zh: 旅途中天气一直糟糕透顶。

entries.definition: morally disgusting or wicked

examples.en: The villain's vile behaviour shocked the audience.
examples.zh: 反派卑鄙的行为震惊了观众。

examples.en: She condemned the vile abuse directed at the volunteers.
examples.zh: 她谴责了针对志愿者的恶劣辱骂。

entries.definition: using physical force to hurt or damage

examples.en: The protest became violent after sunset.
examples.zh: 日落后，抗议演变为暴力冲突。

examples.en: The school has rules against violent behaviour.
examples.zh: 学校有禁止暴力行为的规定。

entries.definition: extremely forceful or intense

examples.en: A violent storm damaged the harbour.
examples.zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雨破坏了港口。

examples.en: The announcement provoked a violent emotional reaction.
examples.zh: 这项公告引发了强烈的情绪反应。

entries.definition: a good moral quality

examples.en: Patience is a useful virtue when teaching beginners.
examples.zh: 教初学者时，耐心是一种有益的美德。

examples.en: The story celebrates the virtue of honesty.
examples.zh: 这个故事赞颂了诚实的美德。

entries.definition: an advantage or useful quality

examples.en: Simplicity is the main virtue of this design.
examples.zh: 简洁是这项设计的主要优点。

examples.en: The plan has the virtue of being easy to explain.
examples.zh: 这个计划的优点是容易解释。

entries.definition: official permission to enter or stay in a country

examples.en: She applied for a student visa.
examples.zh: 她申请了学生签证。

examples.en: His passport contained several old visas.
examples.zh: 他的护照里有几张旧签证。

entries.definition: the ability to see

examples.en: The fog reduced our vision to a few metres.
examples.zh: 雾使我们的视野缩小到几米。

examples.en: The examination checks colour vision.
examples.zh: 这项检查测试色觉。

entries.definition: the ability to imagine a future state or a clear idea of it

examples.en: The architect shared her vision for the new library.
examples.zh: 建筑师分享了她对新图书馆的构想。

examples.en: A leader needs vision as well as practical skills.
examples.zh: 领导者既需要远见，也需要实践能力。

entries.definition: an imagined image or experience that seems real

examples.en: The character sees a vision of his childhood home.
examples.zh: 这个人物眼前浮现出童年故居的幻象。

examples.en: The poem describes a strange vision in the night.
examples.zh: 这首诗描写了夜间的一种奇异幻象。

entries.definition: energy and strength in living or activity

examples.en: The children brought vitality to the quiet house.
examples.zh: 孩子们给安静的屋子带来了活力。

examples.en: The festival reflects the vitality of local culture.
examples.zh: 这个节日反映了当地文化的生命力。

entries.definition: an opening in the Earth's crust through which hot material can erupt

examples.en: The village lies below an inactive volcano.
examples.zh: 村庄位于一座休眠火山下方。

examples.en: Scientists monitor gases released by the volcano.
examples.zh: 科学家监测火山释放的气体。

entries.definition: one book, especially as part of a set

examples.en: The history is published in three volumes.
examples.zh: 这部历史著作分三卷出版。

examples.en: She found the quotation in the second volume.
examples.zh: 她在第二卷中找到了那句话。

entries.definition: the amount of space occupied by something

examples.en: We measured the volume of water in the tank.
examples.zh: 我们测量了水箱中水的体积。

examples.en: The box has twice the volume of the smaller one.
examples.zh: 这个箱子的容积是小箱子的两倍。

entries.definition: the loudness of a sound

examples.en: Please lower the volume of the television.
examples.zh: 请把电视音量调低。

examples.en: The speaker volume was too high for the small room.
examples.zh: 对于这个小房间来说，扬声器音量太大了。

entries.definition: the total amount of something

examples.en: The office handles a large volume of mail.
examples.zh: 办公室处理大量邮件。

examples.en: Traffic volume increases during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假日期间交通流量增加。

entries.definition: to bring stomach contents back through the mouth

examples.en: The passenger vomited during the rough crossing.
examples.zh: 渡海时风浪很大，那位乘客吐了。

examples.en: The nurse asked whether the patient had vomited.
examples.zh: 护士询问患者是否吐过。

entries.definition: to eject material forcefully

examples.en: The damaged pipe vomited dirty water into the street.
examples.zh: 破裂的管道把污水喷到街上。

examples.en: The old chimney vomited smoke into the sky.
examples.zh: 旧烟囱向天空喷出浓烟。

entries.definition: material brought up from the stomach

examples.en: The cleaner found vomit beside the seat.
examples.zh: 清洁工发现座位旁有呕吐物。

examples.en: The sample contained traces of vomit.
examples.zh: 样本中含有呕吐物痕迹。

entries.definition: a substance used to cause vomiting, in old usage

examples.en: The historical ledger lists a vomit among the remedies.
examples.zh: 这份历史账簿在药品中列出了一种催吐剂。

examples.en: The old account records payment for a vomit supplied by an apothecary.
examples.zh: 旧账目记载了购买药剂师所供催吐剂的付款。

entries.definition: easily harmed or affected by danger

examples.en: Young plants are vulnerable to frost.
examples.zh: 幼苗容易遭受霜冻。

examples.en: The report identifies groups vulnerable to sudden price rises.
examples.zh: 报告识别了容易受到价格骤涨影响的群体。

entries.definition: the part of the body between the ribs and hips

examples.en: The jacket fits closely around the waist.
examples.zh: 这件夹克在腰部很贴身。

examples.en: She tied a belt around her waist.
examples.zh: 她在腰间系了一条腰带。

entries.definition: the part of a town beside a river, lake, or sea

examples.en: Restaurants line the waterfront.
examples.zh: 餐馆沿着滨水区排列。

examples.en: The city plans to improve access to the waterfront.
examples.zh: 这座城市计划改善通往滨水区的交通。

entries.definition: to make or become less strong

examples.en: The long drought weakened the trees.
examples.zh: 长期干旱使树木变弱。

examples.en: The new evidence weakened his argument.
examples.zh: 新证据削弱了他的论点。

entries.definition: to gradually stop feeding milk as the main food

examples.en: The young animals were weaned during spring.
examples.zh: 这些幼崽在春季断奶。

examples.en: The farm keeps recently weaned calves in a separate area.
examples.zh: 农场把刚断奶的小牛放在单独区域。

entries.meaning: 使戒掉；使摆脱依赖（wean off）
entries.definition: to gradually reduce dependence on something

examples.en: The programme aims to wean students off constant translation.
examples.zh: 这个项目旨在让学生逐渐摆脱对不断翻译的依赖。

examples.en: The company is trying to wean itself off paper records.
examples.zh: 公司正努力逐步摆脱对纸质记录的依赖。

entries.definition: a plant growing where it is not wanted

examples.en: Weeds grew between the paving stones.
examples.zh: 铺路石之间长出了杂草。

examples.en: The gardener removed a weed from the flower bed.
examples.zh: 园丁从花坛里拔出一株杂草。

entries.definition: to remove unwanted plants

examples.en: We weed the vegetable beds every weekend.
examples.zh: 我们每个周末都给菜畦除草。

examples.en: She spent the morning weeding around the young trees.
examples.zh: 她整个上午都在幼树周围除草。

entries.definition: a state of being healthy, comfortable, and content

examples.en: The school places importance on student well-being.
examples.zh: 学校重视学生的身心健康。

examples.en: Green spaces can contribute to community well-being.
examples.zh: 绿地有助于增进社区福祉。

entries.definition: existing or happening over a large area or among many people

examples.en: The change received widespread support.
examples.zh: 这项变革获得了广泛支持。

examples.en: Flooding caused widespread damage to roads.
examples.zh: 洪水对道路造成了大面积破坏。

entries.definition: the front glass of a motor vehicle

examples.en: Rain covered the windscreen.
examples.zh: 雨水布满了挡风玻璃。

examples.en: A small stone cracked the windscreen.
examples.zh: 一颗小石子把挡风玻璃砸裂了。

entries.definition: to remain strong despite a force or difficulty

examples.en: The roof is designed to withstand heavy snow.
examples.zh: 这个屋顶的设计能够承受厚重积雪。

examples.en: The explanation did not withstand close examination.
examples.zh: 这个解释经不起仔细推敲。

entries.definition: to think about something with curiosity or uncertainty

examples.en: I wonder why the shop is closed.
examples.zh: 我想知道商店为什么关门了。

examples.en: She wondered whether the message had arrived.
examples.zh: 她纳闷消息是否已经送达。

entries.definition: to feel surprised or amazed by something

examples.en: We wondered at the skill of the young musicians.
examples.zh: 我们对年轻音乐家们的技艺感到惊叹。

examples.en: Visitors wonder at the size of the ancient stones.
examples.zh: 游客惊叹于这些古代巨石的体量。

entries.definition: a feeling of amazement

examples.en: The children watched the fireworks in wonder.
examples.zh: 孩子们惊叹地看着烟花。

examples.en: Her voice was filled with wonder at the discovery.
examples.zh: 这次发现使她的声音充满惊喜。

entries.definition: something remarkable that causes amazement

examples.en: The cave is a natural wonder.
examples.zh: 这个洞穴是一处自然奇观。

examples.en: It is a wonder that the fragile vase survived.
examples.zh: 这只易碎花瓶能够保存下来，真是奇迹。

entries.definition: extending across the world

examples.en: The exhibition attracted world-wide interest.
examples.zh: 这场展览引起了全球关注。

examples.en: The organisation has a world-wide network of volunteers.
examples.zh: 这个组织拥有遍布全球的志愿者网络。

entries.definition: throughout the world

examples.en: The book is sold world-wide.
examples.zh: 这本书在全世界销售。

examples.en: The announcement was broadcast world-wide.
examples.zh: 这项公告向全球播出。

entries.definition: deserving a particular response or treatment

examples.en: Her efforts are worthy of recognition.
examples.zh: 她的努力值得肯定。

examples.en: The proposal is worthy of serious consideration.
examples.zh: 这项提议值得认真考虑。

entries.definition: having good qualities or serving a worthwhile purpose

examples.en: They raised money for a worthy cause.
examples.zh: 他们为一项有价值的事业筹款。

examples.en: The committee chose a worthy candidate.
examples.zh: 委员会选出了一位可敬的候选人。

entries.meaning: 不幸的人；可怜的人（文学用语）
entries.definition: a person deserving pity because of suffering

examples.en: The traveller gave the poor wretch a warm coat.
examples.zh: 旅人给了那个可怜人一件暖和的大衣。

examples.en: The novel follows a lonely wretch searching for shelter.
examples.zh: 小说讲述了一个孤苦的人寻找栖身处的故事。

entries.meaning: 可恶的人；坏蛋（文学贬称）
entries.definition: a person regarded with strong disapproval

examples.en: The villain is portrayed as a selfish wretch.
examples.zh: 这个反派被描绘成一个自私的坏蛋。

examples.en: The narrator calls the thief a dishonest wretch.
examples.zh: 叙述者把小偷称作一个不诚实的恶棍。

entries.definition: an area with a particular purpose or characteristic

examples.en: The school lies inside a quiet residential zone.
examples.zh: 学校位于一个安静的住宅区内。

examples.en: This zone is reserved for pedestrians.
examples.zh: 这个区域专供行人使用。

entries.definition: to divide land into areas for particular uses

examples.en: The council zoned the land for housing.
examples.zh: 市政委员会把这块地划为住宅用地。

examples.en: The site is zoned for industrial development.
examples.zh: 这片土地被划定用于工业开发。

entries.definition: land controlled by a country or group

examples.en: The river forms the edge of the territory.
examples.zh: 这条河构成了这片领土的边界。

examples.en: The map shows the island's surrounding territory.
examples.zh: 地图显示了岛屿周边的地域。

entries.definition: an area of knowledge, experience, or activity

examples.en: Online teaching was new territory for him.
examples.zh: 在线教学对他来说是一个新领域。

examples.en: The discussion moved into unfamiliar territory.
examples.zh: 讨论进入了一个陌生领域。

entries.definition: relating to ideas that explain how something works

examples.en: The course provides a theoretical foundation for later practice.
examples.zh: 这门课程为后续实践提供理论基础。

examples.en: Her research challenges the theoretical model.
examples.zh: 她的研究对这个理论模型提出了质疑。

entries.definition: possible in principle but not necessarily in practice

examples.en: The estimate represents the theoretical maximum.
examples.zh: 这个估计代表理论上的最大值。

examples.en: We discussed a theoretical situation in which all roads were closed.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了所有道路都关闭的假设情况。

entries.definition: as a result of the action just described

examples.en: The new route avoids the hill, thereby saving time.
examples.zh: 新路线绕开了山坡，从而节省了时间。

examples.en: She labelled each box, thereby making unpacking easier.
examples.zh: 她给每个箱子贴上标签，从而使拆箱更方便。

entries.definition: a long research document written for a degree

examples.en: She is writing a thesis on urban transport.
examples.zh: 她正在写一篇关于城市交通的学位论文。

examples.en: His thesis includes interviews with local residents.
examples.zh: 他的论文包含对当地居民的访谈。

entries.definition: a central proposition supported by argument

examples.en: The author develops the thesis that design affects behaviour.
examples.zh: 作者论证了设计影响行为这一观点。

examples.en: The final chapter returns to the book's main thesis.
examples.zh: 最后一章回到了全书的核心论点。

entries.definition: having sharp thorns

examples.en: A thorny hedge surrounded the garden.
examples.zh: 一道多刺的树篱环绕着花园。

examples.en: She wore gloves to handle the thorny branches.
examples.zh: 她戴着手套处理带刺的枝条。

entries.definition: involving difficult problems or disagreement

examples.en: The committee faced a thorny question about funding.
examples.zh: 委员会面临一个棘手的经费问题。

examples.en: They postponed the thorny issue until the next meeting.
examples.zh: 他们把这个难题推迟到下次会议讨论。

entries.definition: the lower part of a doorway or the entrance itself

examples.en: He paused on the threshold before entering.
examples.zh: 他进门前在门槛处停了一下。

examples.en: Rainwater gathered outside the threshold.
examples.zh: 雨水积在门槛外。

entries.definition: a level at which something begins or changes

examples.en: The alarm sounds when the temperature passes a threshold.
examples.zh: 温度超过某个阈值时，警报就会响。

examples.en: The study measured the threshold of hearing.
examples.zh: 这项研究测量了听觉阈限。

entries.definition: the beginning of a new stage or experience

examples.en: The town stood on the threshold of major change.
examples.zh: 这座城镇正处于重大变革的开端。

examples.en: She was on the threshold of a new career.
examples.zh: 她即将开始新的职业生涯。

entries.definition: to grow or develop successfully

examples.en: These plants thrive in moist soil.
examples.zh: 这些植物在湿润土壤中茁壮成长。

examples.en: Small businesses thrived after the station opened.
examples.zh: 车站开通后，小企业蓬勃发展。

entries.definition: to mark items on a list as checked or completed

examples.en: Tick off each task when you finish it.
examples.zh: 完成一项任务就打一个勾。

examples.en: She ticked off the names as the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到达时，她逐一勾选名字。

entries.definition: to tell someone that their behaviour was wrong

examples.en: The coach ticked him off for arriving late.
examples.zh: 教练因他迟到而训斥了他。

examples.en: She was ticked off for ignoring the instructions.
examples.zh: 她因不听指示而受到了责备。

entries.definition: to annoy someone

examples.en: The repeated interruptions really ticked her off.
examples.zh: 接二连三的打断让她很生气。

examples.en: It ticks me off when people leave rubbish here.
examples.zh: 有人把垃圾留在这里，这让我生气。

entries.definition: suitable for being worked and used to grow crops

examples.en: Only a small part of the island is tillable.
examples.zh: 岛上只有一小部分土地可以耕种。

examples.en: The survey identified more tillable land near the river.
examples.zh: 调查发现河边有更多可耕地。

entries.definition: lacking confidence or easily frightened

examples.en: The timid child spoke in a quiet voice.
examples.zh: 这个羞怯的孩子说话声音很轻。

examples.en: A timid deer emerged from the trees.
examples.zh: 一只胆小的鹿从树林中走了出来。

entries.definition: to fall or cause something to fall from an upright position

examples.en: The strong wind toppled the empty bins.
examples.zh: 大风吹倒了空垃圾桶。

examples.en: The tower of blocks began to topple.
examples.zh: 积木塔开始倒塌。

entries.definition: to remove a person or group from power

examples.en: The vote toppled the unpopular leadership.
examples.zh: 投票使不受欢迎的领导层下台。

examples.en: The scandal threatened to topple the administration.
examples.zh: 这起丑闻可能使政府倒台。

entries.definition: a powerful fast-moving flow of water

examples.en: Heavy rain turned the stream into a torrent.
examples.zh: 大雨把小溪变成了急流。

examples.en: A torrent rushed down the narrow valley.
examples.zh: 一股洪流冲下狭窄的山谷。

entries.definition: a sudden large flow of words or reactions

examples.en: The announcement produced a torrent of questions.
examples.zh: 这项公告引来了一连串问题。

examples.en: She faced a torrent of criticism after the decision.
examples.zh: 决定作出后，她面临大量批评。

entries.definition: the visual appearance of a town and its buildings

examples.en: The church tower dominates the townscape.
examples.zh: 教堂塔楼是市镇景观中的显著建筑。

examples.en: The proposal aims to preserve the historic townscape.
examples.zh: 提案旨在保护历史悠久的市镇风貌。

entries.definition: to find someone or something by following evidence

examples.en: The team traced the fault to a damaged cable.
examples.zh: 团队查出故障源于一根受损电缆。

examples.en: They traced the missing package to a regional depot.
examples.zh: 他们追踪到丢失包裹在一个地区仓库中。

entries.definition: to follow the origin or development of something

examples.en: The book traces the history of public libraries.
examples.zh: 这本书追溯了公共图书馆的历史。

examples.en: She traced her family roots to a coastal village.
examples.zh: 她追溯到家族起源于一个沿海村庄。

entries.definition: to copy or follow the outline of a shape

examples.en: Place thin paper over the map and trace the river.
examples.zh: 把薄纸放在地图上，描出河流。

examples.en: He traced a circle in the dust with his finger.
examples.zh: 他用手指在灰尘中画了一个圆。

entries.definition: a sign that something existed or happened

examples.en: The storm left little trace on the stone walls.
examples.zh: 暴风雨几乎没在石墙上留下痕迹。

examples.en: No trace of the missing document was found.
examples.zh: 没有找到那份丢失文件的踪迹。

entries.definition: a very small amount

examples.en: The test detected a trace of salt.
examples.zh: 检测发现了微量盐分。

examples.en: There was a trace of sadness in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的声音里有一丝悲伤。

entries.definition: a calm and peaceful state

examples.en: We enjoyed the tranquility of the empty beach.
examples.zh: 我们享受着无人海滩的宁静。

examples.en: The garden offers a place of tranquility in the busy city.
examples.zh: 花园在繁忙城市中提供了一处安宁之地。

entries.definition: to produce a written copy of speech or another text

examples.en: She transcribed the interview from the recording.
examples.zh: 她根据录音转写了采访内容。

examples.en: The students transcribed the old handwritten letters.
examples.zh: 学生们抄录了那些古老的手写信件。

entries.definition: to arrange music for a different instrument or form

examples.en: He transcribed the melody for solo guitar.
examples.zh: 他把这段旋律改编为吉他独奏曲。

examples.en: The pianist transcribed several folk songs.
examples.zh: 钢琴家改编了几首民歌。

entries.definition: the movement of people or goods from one place to another

examples.en: The parcel was damaged in transit.
examples.zh: 包裹在运输途中受损。

examples.en: The city is expanding its public transit network.
examples.zh: 这座城市正在扩大公共交通网络。

entries.definition: to pass through an area or point

examples.en: The ship transited the canal at dawn.
examples.zh: 船在黎明时通过了运河。

examples.en: Many passengers transit through this airport.
examples.zh: 许多乘客经这个机场中转。

entries.definition: to send information, signals, or energy

examples.en: The sensor transmits data every minute.
examples.zh: 传感器每分钟传送一次数据。

examples.en: The antenna transmits a weak radio signal.
examples.zh: 天线发射一个微弱的无线电信号。

entries.definition: to pass a disease or quality from one individual to another

examples.en: Some insects transmit disease between plants.
examples.zh: 一些昆虫在植物之间传播病害。

examples.en: The infection can be transmitted through close contact.
examples.zh: 这种感染可以通过密切接触传播。

entries.definition: to move a plant to a new growing place

examples.en: We transplanted the seedlings into larger pots.
examples.zh: 我们把幼苗移栽到了更大的花盆中。

examples.en: The gardener will transplant the young tree in autumn.
examples.zh: 园丁将在秋天移栽这棵小树。

entries.definition: to transfer an organ or tissue to another location or body

examples.en: The surgeons transplanted a kidney during the operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生在手术中移植了一个肾脏。

examples.en: The team studies how transplanted tissue heals.
examples.zh: 团队研究移植组织如何愈合。

entries.definition: to move people or practices into a new setting

examples.en: The family transplanted its traditions to a new country.
examples.zh: 这个家庭把自己的传统带到了新的国家。

examples.en: The company transplanted the whole department to another city.
examples.zh: 公司把整个部门搬到了另一个城市。

entries.definition: an operation that transfers an organ or tissue

examples.en: She returned to work after the transplant.
examples.zh: 移植手术后，她回去工作了。

examples.en: The transplant took several hours to complete.
examples.zh: 这次移植手术花了几个小时才完成。

entries.definition: an organ or tissue transferred to another body or place

examples.en: The hospital monitors the transplant closely.
examples.zh: 医院密切监测着移植物的情况。

examples.en: The report describes how the transplant began to function.
examples.zh: 报告描述了移植器官如何开始发挥功能。

entries.definition: a device used to catch an animal or object

examples.en: The researchers checked the animal trap each morning.
examples.zh: 研究人员每天早晨检查动物捕捉器。

examples.en: The empty trap was checked and reset.
examples.zh: 空捕捉器经检查后被重新设置。

entries.definition: to catch using a device or deceptive plan

examples.en: The net trapped several fish.
examples.zh: 网捕住了几条鱼。

examples.en: The misleading question trapped him into contradicting himself.
examples.zh: 这个误导性问题诱使他自相矛盾。

entries.definition: to prevent someone or something from escaping

examples.en: Snow trapped the travellers in the village.
examples.zh: 大雪把旅人困在村里。

examples.en: Warm air became trapped under the roof.
examples.zh: 暖空气被困在屋顶下方。

entries.definition: a deceptive plan intended to catch someone out

examples.en: The question was a trap designed to expose his mistake.
examples.zh: 这个问题是为揭露他的错误而设的圈套。

examples.en: She realised that the invitation was a trap.
examples.zh: 她意识到那份邀请是一个圈套。

entries.definition: a detailed formal written study of a subject

examples.en: The library owns an early treatise on astronomy.
examples.zh: 图书馆藏有一部早期天文学专著。

examples.en: Her treatise examines the development of public education.
examples.zh: 她的专题论文探讨了公共教育的发展。

entries.definition: very large in amount or degree

examples.en: The project required a tremendous amount of effort.
examples.zh: 这个项目需要付出巨大的努力。

examples.en: The storm caused tremendous damage.
examples.zh: 暴风雨造成了巨大的破坏。

entries.definition: extremely good or impressive

examples.en: The concert was a tremendous success.
examples.zh: 这场音乐会取得了巨大成功。

examples.en: You have made tremendous progress this term.
examples.zh: 你这学期取得了惊人的进步。

entries.definition: to enter another person's land without permission

examples.en: Visitors must not trespass on the neighbouring farm.
examples.zh: 游客不得擅自进入邻近的农场。

examples.en: The fence discourages people from trespassing.
examples.zh: 篱笆可以阻止人们擅闯。

entries.definition: to make excessive use of someone's time or kindness

examples.en: I do not want to trespass on your hospitality.
examples.zh: 我不想过分占用你的好意招待。

examples.en: The long visit began to trespass on her limited free time.
examples.zh: 这次漫长的拜访开始侵占她有限的空闲时间。

entries.definition: an act of entering property or infringing a right

examples.en: The notice warns against trespass.
examples.zh: 告示警告不得擅闯。

examples.en: They regarded the intrusion as a trespass on their privacy.
examples.zh: 他们把这次闯入视为对隐私的侵犯。

entries.meaning: 冒犯；犯过（正式或旧式用法）
entries.definition: to commit an offence against a moral rule or another person

examples.en: The old prayer asks forgiveness for those who trespass against others.
examples.zh: 这篇古老的祷文请求宽恕那些冒犯他人的人。

examples.en: He believed that he had trespassed against the community's moral code.
examples.zh: 他认为自己违背了社区的道德准则。

entries.definition: relating to a tribe or its way of life

examples.en: The exhibition includes tribal textiles.
examples.zh: 展览包括部落纺织品。

examples.en: The researcher studied tribal traditions in the region.
examples.zh: 研究者考察了该地区的部落传统。

entries.meaning: 集团意识强的；派别鲜明的
entries.definition: showing strong loyalty to a particular group

examples.en: The debate became increasingly tribal.
examples.zh: 这场辩论越来越表现出强烈的派别对立。

examples.en: Tribal loyalties made compromise difficult.
examples.zh: 强烈的集团忠诚使妥协变得困难。

entries.definition: to cause a process or reaction to begin

examples.en: The news triggered a lively debate.
examples.zh: 这条消息引发了一场热烈辩论。

examples.en: A sudden movement triggered the alarm.
examples.zh: 一个突然的动作触发了警报。

entries.definition: a part pressed to activate a gun or mechanism

examples.en: The museum label identifies the trigger on the old pistol.
examples.zh: 博物馆标签指出了旧手枪上的扳机。

examples.en: The tool stops when the operator releases the trigger.
examples.zh: 操作员松开扳机时，工具就停止运行。

entries.definition: something that starts a reaction or event

examples.en: The price increase was the trigger for the dispute.
examples.zh: 价格上涨是争议的导火索。

examples.en: The study looked for a common trigger in the reported incidents.
examples.zh: 研究寻找这些事件中的共同诱因。

entries.definition: a small inexpensive ornament or piece of jewellery

examples.en: She kept a few childhood trinkets in a box.
examples.zh: 她在盒子里保存了一些童年的小饰品。

examples.en: The stall sells colourful trinkets to visitors.
examples.zh: 摊位向游客出售彩色小饰品。

entries.definition: too small or ordinary to be important

examples.en: We should not waste time on trivial details.
examples.zh: 我们不该在琐碎细节上浪费时间。

examples.en: The error seemed trivial but affected the total.
examples.zh: 这个错误看似微小，却影响了总数。

entries.definition: relating to the lowest layer of the atmosphere

examples.en: The study examines tropospheric temperature changes.
examples.zh: 这项研究考察对流层温度变化。

examples.en: Tropospheric clouds affect how much sunlight reaches the surface.
examples.zh: 对流层中的云影响到达地表的阳光量。

entries.definition: an agreement to stop fighting for a period

examples.en: The two sides agreed to a temporary truce.
examples.zh: 双方同意暂时休战。

examples.en: The truce allowed supplies to reach the town.
examples.zh: 停战使物资得以运抵城镇。

entries.definition: a hollow cylinder or a container shaped like one

examples.en: The liquid flows through a narrow tube.
examples.zh: 液体流过一根细管。

examples.en: Put the sample into a clean test tube.
examples.zh: 把样本放进干净的试管。

entries.definition: the underground railway, especially in London

examples.en: We took the Tube across London.
examples.zh: 我们乘地铁穿过伦敦。

examples.en: The nearest Tube station is five minutes away.
examples.zh: 最近的地铁站在五分钟路程外。

entries.definition: to adjust an instrument to the correct pitch

examples.en: The musician tuned the violin before the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐家在音乐会前给小提琴调音。

examples.en: This piano needs to be tuned.
examples.zh: 这架钢琴需要调音。

entries.definition: to adjust equipment for the best performance or reception

examples.en: The mechanic tuned the engine.
examples.zh: 机械师调校了发动机。

examples.en: She tuned the radio to a local station.
examples.zh: 她把收音机调到当地电台。

entries.definition: a sequence of musical notes forming a melody

examples.en: He hummed a familiar tune while cooking.
examples.zh: 他做饭时哼着熟悉的曲调。

examples.en: The song has a cheerful tune.
examples.zh: 这首歌的旋律很欢快。

entries.definition: a state of musical or wider agreement

examples.en: The singers were perfectly in tune.
examples.zh: 歌手们唱得十分合调。

examples.en: The design is in tune with the local landscape.
examples.zh: 这个设计与当地景观相协调。

entries.definition: a machine driven by fluid moving over blades

examples.en: Wind turns the blades of the turbine.
examples.zh: 风带动涡轮机的叶片转动。

examples.en: The power station uses a steam turbine.
examples.zh: 这座发电站使用汽轮机。

entries.definition: a teacher who guides students individually or in small groups

examples.en: Her tutor helped her choose a research topic.
examples.zh: 导师帮助她选择了研究课题。

examples.en: The college assigns a tutor to every new student.
examples.zh: 学院为每位新生安排一位导师。

entries.definition: a teacher hired to give private lessons

examples.en: They hired a tutor to help with mathematics.
examples.zh: 他们请了一位家庭教师辅导数学。

examples.en: The tutor visits the family twice a week.
examples.zh: 家庭教师每周到这家两次。

entries.definition: to teach someone individually or in a small group

examples.en: She tutors younger students after school.
examples.zh: 她放学后辅导低年级学生。

examples.en: He was tutored at home for several months.
examples.zh: 他在家接受了几个月的私人辅导。

entries.definition: having two aspects or parts

examples.en: The purpose of the visit was twofold.
examples.zh: 这次访问有双重目的。

examples.en: The report proposes a twofold strategy.
examples.zh: 报告提出了一个包含两部分的策略。

entries.definition: twice as large in amount or degree

examples.en: The experiment produced a twofold increase in output.
examples.zh: 实验使产出增加到原来的两倍。

examples.en: The new process offers a twofold advantage in speed.
examples.zh: 新工艺在速度方面有两倍的优势。

entries.definition: by a factor of two

examples.en: Demand has increased twofold since last year.
examples.zh: 需求自去年以来增长到了原来的两倍。

examples.en: The number of visitors rose twofold after the renovation.
examples.zh: 翻新后，访客人数增至原来的两倍。

entries.definition: hidden behind the stated reason for an action

examples.en: She wondered whether the offer had an ulterior motive.
examples.zh: 她怀疑这个提议是否别有用心。

examples.en: He helped without any ulterior purpose.
examples.zh: 他提供帮助并无隐藏目的。

entries.meaning: 较远的；后来的（少见用法）
entries.definition: further away or occurring at a later stage

examples.en: The old account describes an ulterior region beyond the hills.
examples.zh: 旧记载描述了群山之外更远的地区。

examples.en: The agreement left ulterior arrangements for another meeting.
examples.zh: 协议把后续安排留待另一次会议讨论。

entries.definition: having an exceptionally low level of contamination

examples.en: The samples were prepared in an ultraclean room.
examples.zh: 样本在超洁净室中制备。

examples.en: The factory uses ultraclean water for delicate components.
examples.zh: 工厂用超纯净水处理精密元件。

entries.definition: impossible or very difficult to defeat

examples.en: The team seemed unbeatable that season.
examples.zh: 那支队伍在那个赛季似乎不可战胜。

examples.en: Her final score was unbeatable.
examples.zh: 她最后的成绩无人能够超越。

entries.definition: better than competing alternatives

examples.en: The shop offers unbeatable value.
examples.zh: 这家店提供的商品物超所值。

examples.en: The balcony gives an unbeatable view of the harbour.
examples.zh: 阳台可以欣赏到无与伦比的海港景色。

entries.definition: a lack of definite knowledge about what will happen

examples.en: Uncertainty about the weather delayed the trip.
examples.zh: 天气的不确定性使旅行推迟了。

examples.en: The estimate includes a measure of uncertainty.
examples.zh: 这个估计包含一个不确定程度指标。

entries.definition: a feeling of being unsure

examples.en: There was uncertainty in his voice.
examples.zh: 他的声音里带着迟疑。

examples.en: She described her uncertainty about choosing a career.
examples.zh: 她描述了自己在职业选择上的犹豫。

entries.definition: to judge an amount, ability, or difficulty as smaller than it is

examples.en: We underestimated the time needed for the repairs.
examples.zh: 我们低估了维修所需的时间。

examples.en: Do not underestimate her ability to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 不要低估她解决这个问题的能力。

entries.definition: an estimate that is below the true amount

examples.en: The initial cost figure was an underestimate.
examples.zh: 最初的成本数字低估了实际费用。

examples.en: Even this large number may be an underestimate.
examples.zh: 即使这个数字很大，也可能仍低于实际数量。

entries.definition: to draw a line beneath a word or passage

examples.en: Underline the main verb in each sentence.
examples.zh: 在每句的主要动词下面画线。

examples.en: She underlined the deadline in red.
examples.zh: 她用红色在截止日期下面画了线。

entries.definition: to show the importance of something

examples.en: The findings underline the need for better data.
examples.zh: 这些发现凸显了改善数据的必要性。

examples.en: His example underlines the importance of preparation.
examples.zh: 他的例子强调了准备的重要性。

entries.definition: clear enough to be understood

examples.en: The guide uses understandable language.
examples.zh: 这份指南使用易懂的语言。

examples.en: The diagram makes the process more understandable.
examples.zh: 图示使这个过程更容易理解。

entries.meaning: 情有可原的；可以体谅的
entries.definition: reasonable or easy to sympathise with

examples.en: Her disappointment was understandable.
examples.zh: 她的失望是可以理解的。

examples.en: Their concern about the delay is understandable.
examples.zh: 他们对延误的担忧情有可原。

entries.definition: not noticed or discovered

examples.en: The error remained undetected for several weeks.
examples.zh: 这个错误几周都未被发现。

examples.en: A small leak went undetected behind the wall.
examples.zh: 墙后的一处小漏水没有被察觉。

entries.definition: feeling worried or uncomfortable

examples.en: She felt uneasy about the sudden change.
examples.zh: 她对突然的变化感到不安。

examples.en: There was an uneasy silence in the room.
examples.zh: 房间里一片令人不安的沉默。

entries.definition: used to introduce an unhappy or disappointing fact

examples.en: Unfortunately, the last train had already left.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，末班火车已经开走了。

examples.en: The plan was promising but unfortunately too expensive.
examples.zh: 这个计划很有前景，可惜成本太高。

entries.definition: being the only one of its kind

examples.en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern.
examples.zh: 每个手工碗都有独一无二的图案。

examples.en: The island is home to a unique species of bird.
examples.zh: 这座岛是一个独有鸟种的家园。

entries.definition: remarkably different from what is usual

examples.en: The course offers a unique learning experience.
examples.zh: 这门课程提供了独特的学习体验。

examples.en: Her unique approach attracted international attention.
examples.zh: 她独特的方法引起了国际关注。

entries.definition: not drawing unwanted attention

examples.en: The hotel staff were helpful but unobtrusive.
examples.zh: 酒店员工乐于助人又不打扰客人。

examples.en: An unobtrusive sign marks the entrance.
examples.zh: 一个不起眼的标志标出了入口。

entries.definition: to mark the end of words being quoted aloud

examples.en: He called the plan quote ambitious unquote.
examples.zh: 他称这个计划是“雄心勃勃的”，并用口头引语标记说明。

examples.en: She described the room as quote cosy unquote, with a doubtful smile.
examples.zh: 她带着怀疑的微笑，口头引用“舒适”来描述房间。

entries.definition: dirty or unsafe in ways that may spread illness

examples.en: The inspection found unsanitary conditions in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 检查发现厨房条件不卫生。

examples.en: Residents complained about the unsanitary waste area.
examples.zh: 居民投诉垃圾区不卫生。

entries.definition: to remove a covering so that something can be seen

examples.en: The mayor unveiled the new statue.
examples.zh: 市长为新雕像揭幕。

examples.en: She unveiled the painting at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在开幕式上揭开了画作的覆盖物。

entries.definition: to make something known publicly for the first time

examples.en: The team unveiled its design for the bridge.
examples.zh: 团队首次公布了桥梁设计。

examples.en: The company will unveil the new product next month.
examples.zh: 公司将在下个月展示新产品。

entries.definition: containing the latest information or using current methods

examples.en: The website provides up-to-date travel information.
examples.zh: 网站提供最新的出行信息。

examples.en: The laboratory needs up-to-date equipment.
examples.zh: 实验室需要现代化设备。

entries.definition: located above another part

examples.en: The books are on the upper shelf.
examples.zh: 书在上层架子上。

examples.en: The upper floor has three bedrooms.
examples.zh: 楼上有三间卧室。

entries.definition: higher in rank, level, or position

examples.en: The issue was discussed by upper management.
examples.zh: 高层管理人员讨论了这个问题。

examples.en: Students in the upper grades take more specialised courses.
examples.zh: 高年级学生修读更多专业化课程。

entries.definition: requiring immediate attention or action

examples.en: The office received an urgent request for assistance.
examples.zh: 办公室收到了紧急求助请求。

examples.en: Repairs to the roof are becoming urgent.
examples.zh: 屋顶维修变得越来越紧迫。

entries.definition: expressing a strong need for immediate action

examples.en: There was an urgent knock at the door.
examples.zh: 门外传来急促的敲门声。

examples.en: Her urgent tone made everyone stop talking.
examples.zh: 她急切的语气让所有人都停止了交谈。

entries.definition: the use of something for a practical purpose

examples.en: The report examines energy utilization in factories.
examples.zh: 报告考察了工厂的能源利用情况。

examples.en: Better utilization of space made the room more useful.
examples.zh: 更合理地利用空间使房间更实用。

entries.definition: available because nobody is occupying it

examples.en: The flat has been vacant for months.
examples.zh: 这套公寓已空置数月。

examples.en: Two positions remain vacant in the department.
examples.zh: 部门里仍有两个职位空缺。

entries.definition: showing little thought or attention

examples.en: He stared at the screen with a vacant expression.
examples.zh: 他神情茫然地盯着屏幕。

examples.en: Her vacant look suggested that she had not heard the question.
examples.zh: 她无神的表情表明她没有听到问题。

entries.definition: not clear, exact, or detailed

examples.en: The instructions were too vague to follow.
examples.zh: 说明太含糊，无法照着做。

examples.en: I have a vague memory of visiting that town.
examples.zh: 我模糊记得去过那个镇。

entries.definition: a road vehicle with an enclosed space for carrying goods or people

examples.en: The delivery van arrived before breakfast.
examples.zh: 送货车在早餐前到达了。

examples.en: They loaded the equipment into a rented van.
examples.zh: 他们把设备装进一辆租来的货车。

entries.definition: differing from a usual or related form

examples.en: The dictionary lists several variant spellings.
examples.zh: 词典列出了几种不同拼法。

examples.en: The two manuscripts contain variant readings of the same line.
examples.zh: 两份手稿对同一句话有不同的文本形式。

entries.definition: a related but different form of something

examples.en: This song is a regional variant of an older melody.
examples.zh: 这首歌是一个更古老曲调的地方变体。

examples.en: The software is available in two variants.
examples.zh: 这款软件有两个不同版本。

entries.meaning: 随机变量；变量值（统计学少见用法）
entries.definition: a statistical variate or one of its numerical values

examples.en: The old statistics text treats height as a measurable variant.
examples.zh: 这本旧统计学教材把身高视为可测量的变量。

examples.en: Each observed variant was entered into the frequency table.
examples.zh: 每个观测到的变量值都被填入频数表。

entries.definition: of several different kinds

examples.en: The workshop attracted people from various professions.
examples.zh: 研讨会吸引了来自不同职业的人。

examples.en: We considered various ways to reduce waste.
examples.zh: 我们考虑了减少浪费的多种方法。

entries.definition: a person who does not eat meat or fish

examples.en: One guest is a vegetarian, so we prepared a separate dish.
examples.zh: 一位客人是素食者，所以我们另备了一道菜。

examples.en: The restaurant is popular with vegetarians.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅很受素食者欢迎。

entries.definition: containing no meat or fish

examples.en: The menu includes several vegetarian options.
examples.zh: 菜单包含几种素食选择。

examples.en: She made a vegetarian curry for dinner.
examples.zh: 她晚餐做了素食咖喱。

entries.definition: the speed of motion, in physics including its direction

examples.en: The instrument measures the velocity of the moving air.
examples.zh: 仪器测量流动空气的速度。

examples.en: The ball's velocity changed when it struck the wall.
examples.zh: 球撞墙后速度发生了变化。

entries.definition: to go somewhere despite risk or uncertainty

examples.en: Few visitors venture beyond the marked path.
examples.zh: 很少有游客冒险走出标记好的小路。

examples.en: We ventured into the forest at dawn.
examples.zh: 我们在黎明时冒险进入森林。

entries.definition: to say something cautiously despite possible disagreement

examples.en: She ventured an opinion during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在会上试探着提出了意见。

examples.en: May I venture a suggestion about the layout?
examples.zh: 我可以试着对布局提个建议吗？

entries.definition: to risk money or something valuable

examples.en: He ventured his savings on a small business.
examples.zh: 他冒险把积蓄投进了一家小企业。

examples.en: The team was unwilling to venture more time on the untested idea.
examples.zh: 团队不愿再冒险把时间投入未经验证的想法。

entries.definition: an activity or business involving uncertainty

examples.en: The café was their first business venture.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆是他们第一次创业尝试。

examples.en: The joint venture brought together two local firms.
examples.zh: 这项合资事业使两家当地公司联合起来。

entries.definition: a formal decision reached in a legal case

examples.en: The jury returned its verdict after a long discussion.
examples.zh: 陪审团长时间讨论后作出了裁决。

examples.en: The family waited quietly for the verdict.
examples.zh: 这家人静静等待判决。

entries.definition: a considered opinion about something

examples.en: What is your verdict on the new design?
examples.zh: 你对新设计有什么看法？

examples.en: The critics' verdict was largely positive.
examples.zh: 评论家的评价大体积极。

entries.definition: the language used in everyday life by a community

examples.en: The guide spoke to the residents in the local vernacular.
examples.zh: 导游用当地话与居民交谈。

examples.en: The poet chose the vernacular rather than formal language.
examples.zh: 诗人选择了日常用语而非正式语言。

entries.definition: a traditional style shaped by local materials and practices

examples.en: The new houses draw on the regional vernacular.
examples.zh: 这些新房借鉴了当地传统建筑风格。

examples.en: Stone walls are central to the area's architectural vernacular.
examples.zh: 石墙是该地区民间建筑风格的重要组成部分。

entries.meaning: 本地语言的；日常语言的
entries.definition: using the ordinary language of a community

examples.en: The library preserves vernacular literature.
examples.zh: 图书馆保存着本土语言文学作品。

examples.en: The translation uses familiar vernacular expressions.
examples.zh: 译文使用熟悉的日常表达。

entries.definition: used to show opposition or comparison

examples.en: The final is North College versus South College.
examples.zh: 决赛由北学院对阵南学院。

examples.en: The essay compares public versus private transport.
examples.zh: 这篇文章比较了公共交通与私人交通。

entries.definition: a large craft used on water

examples.en: The vessel entered the harbour at sunrise.
examples.zh: 船在日出时驶入港口。

examples.en: A research vessel collected samples offshore.
examples.zh: 一艘科考船在近海采集样本。

entries.definition: a hollow object used to hold liquid or other material

examples.en: The liquid was heated in a glass vessel.
examples.zh: 液体在玻璃容器中加热。

examples.en: Archaeologists found a clay vessel near the wall.
examples.zh: 考古学家在墙边发现了一个陶制器皿。

entries.definition: a tube carrying fluid within a living organism

examples.en: The diagram shows the major blood vessels.
examples.zh: 图示显示了主要血管。

examples.en: Water moves through vessels in the plant stem.
examples.zh: 水通过植物茎中的导管流动。

entries.definition: a professional trained to treat animal illnesses and injuries

examples.en: The veterinarian examined the horse's leg.
examples.zh: 兽医检查了马的腿。

examples.en: She hopes to become a veterinarian after university.
examples.zh: 她希望大学毕业后成为兽医。

entries.meaning: 充满活力的；生气勃勃的
entries.definition: full of energy and activity

examples.en: The neighbourhood has a vibrant arts scene.
examples.zh: 这个街区的艺术活动充满活力。

examples.en: Her vibrant personality made visitors feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她充满朝气的个性让访客感到亲切。

entries.definition: strong and bright in colour

examples.en: The painting uses vibrant reds and oranges.
examples.zh: 这幅画使用了鲜艳的红色和橙色。

examples.en: Vibrant flowers filled the garden.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的花朵开满了花园。

entries.definition: resonating with a strong or lively sound

examples.en: The singer's vibrant voice filled the hall.
examples.zh: 歌手洪亮的声音响彻大厅。

examples.en: The instrument produced a vibrant tone.
examples.zh: 乐器发出了富有共鸣的音调。

entries.definition: likely to attack or cause serious physical harm

examples.en: The sign warned visitors about a vicious dog.
examples.zh: 告示提醒访客当心凶犬。

examples.en: The character survived a vicious attack.
examples.zh: 这个人物在一次凶狠袭击中幸存。

entries.definition: deliberately cruel or malicious

examples.en: The review contained vicious personal remarks.
examples.zh: 评论包含恶毒的人身攻击。

examples.en: She refused to repeat the vicious rumour.
examples.zh: 她拒绝传播那个恶毒的谣言。

entries.definition: causing a harmful process to become worse

examples.en: The family was caught in a vicious cycle of debt.
examples.zh: 这家人陷入了债务的恶性循环。

examples.en: Poor sleep and worry created a vicious circle.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足与担忧形成了恶性循环。

entries.definition: a particular way of considering an issue

examples.en: The discussion included several different viewpoints.
examples.zh: 讨论包含了几种不同的观点。

examples.en: Try to understand the problem from her viewpoint.
examples.zh: 试着从她的角度理解问题。

entries.definition: a place offering a good view

examples.en: We stopped at a viewpoint above the valley.
examples.zh: 我们在山谷上方的观景点停了下来。

examples.en: The path leads to a coastal viewpoint.
examples.zh: 小路通向一处海岸观景点。

entries.definition: to act against a rule, agreement, or principle

examples.en: The decision violates the agreement.
examples.zh: 这个决定违反了协议。

examples.en: Drivers who violate the parking rules may receive a notice.
examples.zh: 违反停车规则的司机可能收到通知。

entries.definition: to interfere with someone's rights or protected space

examples.en: Publishing the private letters would violate her privacy.
examples.zh: 公布私人信件会侵犯她的隐私。

examples.en: The policy was criticised for violating basic rights.
examples.zh: 这项政策因侵犯基本权利而受到批评。

entries.meaning: 亵渎；扰乱神圣或安宁之物
entries.definition: to treat something sacred or protected with disrespect

examples.en: The vandals violated the sanctity of the shrine.
examples.zh: 破坏者亵渎了神殿的神圣性。

examples.en: Loud machinery violated the silence of the old cemetery.
examples.zh: 喧闹的机器声打破了旧墓地的宁静。

entries.definition: showing good moral principles

examples.en: The tale rewards the honest and virtuous hero.
examples.zh: 故事让诚实正直的主人公获得了回报。

examples.en: She tried to live a virtuous life.
examples.zh: 她努力过一种有道德的生活。

entries.meaning: 自命清高的；自以为高尚的（贬义）
entries.definition: feeling or displaying excessive moral superiority

examples.en: He gave a virtuous smile after pointing out everyone else's faults.
examples.zh: 指出别人的过错后，他露出自以为高尚的微笑。

examples.en: Her virtuous tone annoyed colleagues who had also worked hard.
examples.zh: 她自命清高的语气惹恼了同样努力工作的同事。

entries.definition: sexually chaste, in traditional moral descriptions

examples.en: The old novel presents its heroine as virtuous and unmarried.
examples.zh: 这部旧小说把女主人公描写为贞洁的未婚女子。

examples.en: The historian examines how women were labelled virtuous in those texts.
examples.zh: 历史学家探讨了那些文本如何给女性贴上贞洁标签。

entries.definition: thick and slow to flow

examples.en: The viscous liquid moved slowly through the tube.
examples.zh: 黏稠的液体缓慢流过管子。

examples.en: The mixture became more viscous as it cooled.
examples.zh: 混合物冷却后变得更黏稠。

entries.definition: relating to seeing or to what can be seen

examples.en: The teacher used visual aids to explain the process.
examples.zh: 老师用视觉辅助材料解释了这个过程。

examples.en: The report includes a visual comparison of the two designs.
examples.zh: 报告对两种设计进行了直观比较。

entries.definition: strong and clear in colour

examples.en: The curtains were a vivid shade of green.
examples.zh: 窗帘呈鲜艳的绿色。

examples.en: A vivid orange sunset lit the sky.
examples.zh: 明亮的橙色晚霞照亮了天空。

entries.definition: producing a strong and detailed mental image

examples.en: She gave a vivid account of the journey.
examples.zh: 她生动地描述了旅程。

examples.en: He still has vivid memories of his first school.
examples.zh: 他仍清楚地记得第一所学校。

entries.definition: the unit of electric potential difference

examples.en: The label states that the battery supplies twelve volts.
examples.zh: 标签说明电池提供十二伏电压。

examples.en: The meter displayed a reading of five volts.
examples.zh: 仪表显示读数为五伏。

entries.definition: done by free choice rather than compulsion

examples.en: Participation in the survey is voluntary.
examples.zh: 参加调查是自愿的。

examples.en: She does voluntary work at the community centre.
examples.zh: 她在社区中心做志愿工作。

entries.definition: controlled consciously, especially of body movement

examples.en: The lesson distinguishes voluntary movement from reflex action.
examples.zh: 这节课区分随意运动与反射动作。

examples.en: Raising your hand is a voluntary action.
examples.zh: 举手是一个受意志控制的动作。

entries.definition: a long journey, especially by sea or in space

examples.en: The voyage across the ocean lasted several weeks.
examples.zh: 横跨大洋的航程持续了几周。

examples.en: The diary describes the ship's first voyage.
examples.zh: 日记描述了船的第一次航行。

entries.definition: to travel on a long journey by sea or in space

examples.en: They voyaged along the coast in a small boat.
examples.zh: 他们乘小船沿海岸航行。

examples.en: The explorers voyaged far beyond familiar waters.
examples.zh: 探险者远航到远离熟悉水域的地方。

entries.definition: money paid to a worker for their labour

examples.en: The workers received their wages on Friday.
examples.zh: 工人们在星期五领到了工资。

examples.en: She earns a fair wage for skilled work.
examples.zh: 她凭技术工作获得合理报酬。

entries.definition: to carry on a campaign or struggle

examples.en: The group waged a campaign to protect the park.
examples.zh: 这个团体开展了一场保护公园的运动。

examples.en: The company waged a long battle against counterfeit goods.
examples.zh: 公司长期打击假冒产品。

entries.definition: to walk without a fixed route or purpose

examples.en: We wandered through the old market.
examples.zh: 我们在老市场里闲逛。

examples.en: She likes to wander along the river after work.
examples.zh: 她喜欢下班后沿河漫步。

entries.definition: to move away from the intended path or subject

examples.en: The discussion wandered away from the main issue.
examples.zh: 讨论偏离了主要议题。

examples.en: The sheep wandered out of the field.
examples.zh: 羊走出了田地。

entries.definition: to lose concentration and think of other things

examples.en: My mind began to wander during the long speech.
examples.zh: 冗长的讲话让我开始走神。

examples.en: His attention wandered towards the open window.
examples.zh: 他的注意力转向了敞开的窗户。

entries.definition: material or resources lost without useful result

examples.en: Careful planning reduced food wastage.
examples.zh: 周密计划减少了食物浪费。

examples.en: The factory measures wastage at each production stage.
examples.zh: 工厂测量每个生产阶段的损耗量。

entries.definition: a reduction in staff as people leave and are not replaced

examples.en: The firm reduced staff through natural wastage.
examples.zh: 公司通过自然减员减少了员工数量。

examples.en: High wastage among new recruits worried the manager.
examples.zh: 新员工的大量流失让经理担忧。

entries.definition: preventing water from passing through

examples.en: Wear a waterproof jacket on the hike.
examples.zh: 徒步时穿一件防水夹克。

examples.en: The documents were kept in a waterproof bag.
examples.zh: 文件放在一个防水袋里。

entries.definition: to treat a material so water cannot pass through it

examples.en: The builders waterproofed the roof.
examples.zh: 施工人员给屋顶做了防水处理。

examples.en: This coating helps waterproof the fabric.
examples.zh: 这种涂层有助于使布料防水。

entries.definition: a lack of physical strength or energy

examples.en: She felt weakness in her legs after the climb.
examples.zh: 爬山后，她感到双腿无力。

examples.en: The patient described a period of unusual weakness.
examples.zh: 患者描述了一段异常虚弱的时期。

entries.definition: a fault or limitation

examples.en: The report identifies a weakness in the design.
examples.zh: 报告指出了设计中的一个弱点。

examples.en: Every method has strengths and weaknesses.
examples.zh: 每种方法都有优点和缺点。

entries.definition: a strong liking that is difficult to resist

examples.en: He has a weakness for old maps.
examples.zh: 他对旧地图格外着迷。

examples.en: Chocolate is her one weakness.
examples.zh: 巧克力是她难以抗拒的偏爱。

entries.definition: an object used to attack or defend

examples.en: The museum displays ancient weapons behind glass.
examples.zh: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列古代武器。

examples.en: The guard asked visitors to leave any weapons outside.
examples.zh: 警卫要求访客把任何武器留在外面。

entries.definition: something used to gain an advantage in a struggle

examples.en: Accurate information is a useful weapon against rumours.
examples.zh: 准确信息是对抗谣言的有力工具。

examples.en: Humour became her strongest weapon in the debate.
examples.zh: 幽默成了她在辩论中最有力的手段。

entries.definition: to measure how heavy something is

examples.en: The assistant weighed the parcel before posting it.
examples.zh: 助理寄包裹前称了重量。

examples.en: Weigh the flour before adding it to the bowl.
examples.zh: 先称好面粉，再加入碗中。

entries.definition: to have a particular weight

examples.en: The suitcase weighs eighteen kilograms.
examples.zh: 这个旅行箱重十八公斤。

examples.en: The newborn calf weighed more than expected.
examples.zh: 这头新生小牛比预期更重。

entries.definition: to consider the relative importance of different factors

examples.en: We weighed the benefits against the costs.
examples.zh: 我们权衡了收益与成本。

examples.en: She is weighing whether to accept the offer.
examples.zh: 她正认真考虑是否接受邀请。

entries.definition: the practice or industry of hunting whales

examples.en: The museum examines the history of whaling.
examples.zh: 博物馆介绍捕鲸业的历史。

examples.en: The documentary explores the effects of commercial whaling.
examples.zh: 纪录片探讨了商业捕鲸的影响。

entries.definition: to speak very quietly

examples.en: She whispered the answer to her friend.
examples.zh: 她低声告诉朋友答案。

examples.en: Please do not whisper during the performance.
examples.zh: 演出时请不要交头接耳。

entries.definition: very quiet speech

examples.en: His voice dropped to a whisper.
examples.zh: 他的声音压低成了耳语。

examples.en: I could hear a whisper from the next room.
examples.zh: 我能听到隔壁房间的低语声。

entries.definition: animals and plants living in natural conditions

examples.en: The wetland supports a wide variety of wildlife.
examples.zh: 湿地养育了多种野生生物。

examples.en: Visitors should avoid disturbing the wildlife.
examples.zh: 游客应避免惊扰野生生物。

entries.definition: metal drawn into a long thin flexible strand

examples.en: She bent the wire into a small loop.
examples.zh: 她把金属丝弯成了一个小环。

examples.en: The fence is made of strong steel wire.
examples.zh: 篱笆由结实的钢丝制成。

entries.definition: a metal conductor carrying electric current or signals

examples.en: A loose wire caused the lamp to flicker.
examples.zh: 一根松动电线使灯闪烁。

examples.en: The electrician replaced the damaged wire.
examples.zh: 电工更换了损坏的电线。

entries.definition: to connect equipment or a building with electrical wiring

examples.en: The house was wired before the walls were finished.
examples.zh: 房屋在墙面完工前铺好了电线。

examples.en: The technician wired the sensor to the control unit.
examples.zh: 技术员把传感器接到了控制单元上。

entries.definition: a person who sees an event or gives evidence about it

examples.en: A witness described the vehicle to the police.
examples.zh: 一位目击者向警方描述了那辆车。

examples.en: The witness answered questions clearly.
examples.zh: 证人清楚地回答了问题。

entries.definition: evidence showing that something happened or is true

examples.en: The old walls bear witness to centuries of change.
examples.zh: 这些古墙见证了数百年的变迁。

examples.en: The photographs stand as witness to the village's past.
examples.zh: 这些照片是村庄过去的见证。

entries.definition: to see an event happen

examples.en: Several passengers witnessed the accident.
examples.zh: 几位乘客目击了事故。

examples.en: The town has witnessed rapid growth.
examples.zh: 这座城镇经历了迅速发展。

entries.definition: to confirm an event or signature as an observer

examples.en: Two people witnessed the signing of the agreement.
examples.zh: 两人见证了协议签署。

examples.en: She was asked to witness his signature.
examples.zh: 她被请来为他的签名作证。

entries.definition: a person who works excessively and finds it hard to stop

examples.en: His friends worry that he has become a workaholic.
examples.zh: 朋友们担心他已经成了工作狂。

examples.en: The novel follows a workaholic learning to make time for family.
examples.zh: 小说讲述了一个工作狂学着为家人留出时间的故事。

entries.definition: a small animal with a long soft body and no legs

examples.en: A worm moved through the damp soil.
examples.zh: 一条蠕虫在潮湿土壤里蠕动。

examples.en: The bird pulled a worm from the lawn.
examples.zh: 鸟从草坪中叼出一条虫。

entries.definition: a screw-like mechanical part that drives a gear

examples.en: The worm turns the gear at a reduced speed.
examples.zh: 蜗杆以较低速度带动齿轮。

examples.en: The mechanic inspected the worm for wear.
examples.zh: 机械师检查了蜗杆的磨损情况。

entries.definition: to cover or wind material around something

examples.en: Wrap the glass carefully before packing it.
examples.zh: 装箱前把玻璃杯仔细包好。

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她把围巾围在脖子上。

entries.definition: a piece of clothing worn loosely around the shoulders

examples.en: She brought a light wrap for the cool evening.
examples.zh: 她带了一条薄披肩应对凉爽的夜晚。

examples.en: The woollen wrap kept her warm on the terrace.
examples.zh: 羊毛披肩让她在露台上保持温暖。

entries.definition: a small line or fold in skin or material

examples.en: Fine wrinkles appeared around his eyes.
examples.zh: 他的眼周出现了细纹。

examples.en: There was a wrinkle in the freshly folded shirt.
examples.zh: 刚叠好的衬衫上有一道褶皱。

entries.definition: to form or cause small folds

examples.en: The fabric wrinkles easily in a suitcase.
examples.zh: 这种布料放在旅行箱里容易起皱。

examples.en: She wrinkled her nose at the strange smell.
examples.zh: 闻到奇怪气味时，她皱起了鼻子。

entries.definition: relating to the scientific study of animals

examples.en: The museum houses a large zoological collection.
examples.zh: 博物馆收藏了大量动物学标本。

examples.en: The expedition gathered zoological data from the island.
examples.zh: 考察队从岛上收集了动物学数据。
